source: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 Global Relief Model, 60 arc-second surface elevation (public domain), read at a 2 arc-minute stride via the NCEI THREDDS OPeNDAP service; land cover from NASA MODIS MCD12 IGBP annual land cover (2022) as rendered by NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), decoded with the GIBS MODIS_IGBP_Land_Cover_Type colormap (public domain). Aggregated per region by scripts/build-geography.ts over the game’s region-ID raster.
licence: NOAA ETOPO 2022: public domain (US Government). NASA MODIS/GIBS imagery: public domain (NASA).
notes: elevMean/elevStd/elevMax in metres over land cells (sea below 0 clamped to 0); ruggedness = mean absolute elevation difference to the four neighbouring 2-arc-minute cells (≈3.7 km), i.e. a terrain ruggedness index in metres. cover = area shares of IGBP class groups (forest = evergreen/deciduous needleleaf, deciduous broadleaf and mixed forest; jungle = evergreen broadleaf; woodland = woody savanna (open boreal/subtropical forest); shrub = closed+open shrublands; savanna; cropland = croplands + cropland/natural mosaic; marsh = permanent wetlands; barren; ice = permanent snow and ice; water). terrain = classifyTerrain() in scripts/build-geography.ts (see classifier). waterBodies = ids of the 4-connected water bodies (≥ 40 raster pixels) the region borders, largest first; landings are only possible between regions sharing one.
classifier: ice: Antarctica or ice ≥ 0.5; urban: urban ≥ 0.12; mountains: ruggedness ≥ 130 m or (≥ 100 m and elevStd ≥ 450 m) or elevMean ≥ 3500 m; jungle: evergreen broadleaf ≥ 0.30 within 30° of the equator; marsh: wetlands ≥ 0.12; desert: barren + ½·shrub ≥ 0.45 and annual precipitation < 400 mm; arctic: annual mean temperature < −2 °C and forest < 0.35; hills: ruggedness ≥ 70 m; forest: forest + jungle + 0.7·woodland ≥ 0.45; else plains.
